import time
import datetime

def remind_at_8pm():
    now = datetime.datetime.now()
    eight_pm = now.replace(hour=20, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
    
    if now > eight_pm:
        eight_pm = eight_pm + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
    
    wait_seconds = (eight_pm - now).total_seconds()
    print(f"Waiting {wait_seconds} seconds until 8 PM.")
    time.sleep(wait_seconds)
    print("It's 8 PM! Go to sleep!")
